repairs: CAD generator D-flat corrected to 4.5 mm across (was 4.75), shaft ref rebound; assumption trait declares plain-bore M3 holes
assumptions: CAD corner chamfer, lead exit housing, lead stub, hole bore
vocabulary_gaps: New leaf protocol type stepper_phase (roles input on the motor lead, output on the driver terminal, capability stepper_phase) for one end of a stepper winding. No builder covers stepper windings; bldc_phase is 3-phase brushless and power/bidirectional (used by stepperonline-17hs19-2004s1) does not pair motor to driver. Proposed: a StepperPhases builder mirroring BrushlessPhases.

bipolar_stepper_phases already exists (stepperonline-17hs19-2004s1, role motor, power-typed leads). This part uses role input (motor) with output on the driver so the pair validates; the 17HS19 part should converge on input/output and stepper_phase leaves (integrator decision).

phase_current (A) is not a canonical parameter id. It is used on both stepper and driver composed interfaces so DRC range-checks the motor's rated current against the driver's settable range (max_current is a capacity id and is skipped by the pair check).
